# SarkariChart (सरकारी चार्ट)

> Every new Indian government job, admit card, result and answer key from official websites, in English and Hindi. Each notice page is written from the official notice PDF and links to it.

- Checks about 50 official recruitment boards every 30 minutes (UPSC, SSC, RRB, IBPS, state PSCs, police boards, banks, defence).
- Dates shown are the dates the board issued the notice. If anything differs, the official notice is correct.
- Independent website, not a government website. Free; never asks for money.

## Pages
- [Home: latest notices](https://sarkarichart.pages.dev/)
- [About](https://sarkarichart.pages.dev/about/)
- [Contact](https://sarkarichart.pages.dev/contact/)
- [Sitemap](https://sarkarichart.pages.dev/sitemap.xml)
